invariants.claim: Successful redemption requires an unconsumed winner, a winning terminal result, the winning ticket ID and caller equal to its current live owner.
invariants.evidence: Raffle.sol L310-L321; L538, L551-L552; ERC721.sol L426-L431

invariants.claim: Recipient, redeemed flag and ticket burn precede either mutable external asset call.
NFT success requires prizeClaimed set and a post-transfer ownership report equal to winner; cash success consumes the entire positive winnerProceeds before transfer.
Optional settlement preserves gross allocation conservation and binds the ID without selecting a recipient or sending assets.
NFT branch returns zero cash; cash branch returns the consumed amount and zero NFT event fields.

assumptions.claim: Winning range represents an existing current owner at redemption.
assumptions.establishedBy: Range membership: Raffle.sol L538, L579-L585; existence separately established by L320 and ERC721.sol L426-L431. ticketRange alone merely returns stored bounds at Raffle.sol L451-L455.

assumptions.claim: Burn is authorized even though its internal helper skips sender authorization.
assumptions.establishedBy: Raffle.sol L320-L321 supplies authorization before ERC721.sol L303-L308 calls _update with zero auth; ERC721.sol L220-L222 skips the auth branch.

assumptions.claim: The prize contract reports real ownership after transfer.
assumptions.establishedBy: nothing found; Raffle.sol L334-L336 trusts the same configured external contract for both operations; IRaffle.sol L14-L15 states the supported-prize honesty assumption.

assumptions.claim: The quote token transfers the exact amount without fees or rebasing and is canonical USDC.
assumptions.establishedBy: nothing found as a runtime delivery/identity proof; explicit trust model at IRaffle.sol L12-L15 and Raffle.sol L560-L561; Factory L58-L77 checks metadata and assigns identity verification to deployment tooling.

assumptions.claim: ERC721 owner balances agree with ownership before unchecked burn decrement.
assumptions.establishedBy: Shared ERC721.sol _update accounting L216-L244 and mint checks L259-L267; no independent balance assertion at burn.

calls.propagates: Rejects ENTERED, sets ENTERED before body and NOT_ENTERED after; zero initial clone storage is accepted. ReentrancyGuard.sol L69-L117; StorageSlot.sol L93-L97.
Validates winning status/range, allocates gross liabilities and binds ID once; never establishes live ownership or recipient. Raffle.sol L533-L558, L579-L585, L451-L455.

Floor multiplication/division; zero denominator or excessive quotient rejects. Canonical bounded gross uses the low-product branch. Math.sol L37-L46, L143-L150, L206-L277; SafeCast.sol L1157-L1161; Panic.sol L50-L56; Raffle.sol L219-L233.
Reads local ticket owner and rejects nonexistent/burned IDs; no prize call. ERC721.sol L61-L63, L146-L148, L426-L431.

Burn skips destination screening and auth checks, clears per-ticket approval and ownership, decrements owner balance and emits Transfer; caller must authorize first. Raffle.sol L321, L497-L502; ERC721.sol L216-L244, L303-L308, L383-L399.
Zero-value mutable call may reject, reenter unguarded interfaces or implement arbitrary behavior; claim state is consumed before it. Raffle.sol L323-L334; IERC721.sol L91.
Read-only query must decode to winner or redemption fails; truthful ownership is not independently established. Raffle.sol L335-L336; IERC721.sol L39.
Rejects known protocol destinations before token call; registry queried only for code-bearing addresses not already classified. Raffle.sol L564-L567, L593-L605.
Immutable implementation and registration mapping support same-factory destination screening. Factory.sol L42, L54, L89-L91, L123-L125; Raffle.sol L601-L603.
Bubbles revert; accepts successful first return word 1 or empty return from code-bearing token, otherwise rejects. Does not measure balances. SafeERC20.sol L33-L37, L176-L200.
Receives zero native value and full winner allocation after zeroing liability; exact accounting depends on canonical-token trust assumption. Raffle.sol L339-L342, L560-L566; SafeERC20.sol L176-L196.

callers: External arbitrary caller; current owner must pass Raffle.sol L321; approvals alone do not authorize this entrypoint (L309-L321).
sharedState: Winner/result/ranges and settlement allocation: Raffle.sol L209-L237, L304-L306, L509-L558.
Winner recipient/redeemed flag/proceeds, prizeClaimed and ERC721 ownership: Raffle.sol L323-L342, L395-L407; ERC721.sol L216-L244.
Sponsor/protocol separate releases and total accounted liabilities: Raffle.sol L375-L392, L468-L470.
openQuestions: unclear; need to inspect the configured prize implementation to establish truthful transfer and ownership-report semantics; paired external calls alone do not establish them (Raffle.sol L334-L336; IRaffle.sol L14-L15).
